bends.note: angle point: straight (horizontal on sheet) to the north/left, angles off to the south-east (rising to the right on the sheet) beyond

ends.note: stops at a property line (narrow strip in front of the pink works on the sheet-280 side) just past the 20 ft alley

notes: Sheet is rotated: north is to the LEFT (compass), so Colerain runs along the top, Spring Grove along the bottom, and Alabama, Bates and Ethan run top-to-bottom; Garrard runs left-to-right from Ethan. Two separate streets are printed 'BATES AV.': a short piece EAST of Colerain (x~1252, faces 1100/1401, no width printed, mapping stops at y~1550) and the 50 ft street WEST of Colerain between Alabama and Ethan (x~1938) that runs through to Spring Grove; they are offset ~700 px along Colerain, so they carry (east of Colerain)/(west of Colerain) suffixes. Stock Avenue (no width printed, ~26 ft between faces) enters from the east side of Colerain at the top and runs off the mapped area. The ~12 ft gap (faces 399/475, no name or width printed here) running from Colerain's east side opposite Alabama to where mapping stops is named 'Bates Alley' from the key map ('BATES' printed there east of Colerain) and sheet 293, which records it as 'Bates Alley' (10 ft) ~22 px from Alabama; it is given both as a T and as an alley segment. Unnamed alleys: a 10 ft alley parallel to Colerain from Bates to Ethan; a 20 ft alley from Colerain to the east end of Garrard. Spring Grove's south face is off the paper: its centre was computed 300 px (50 ft) south of the north face and agrees with the midpoint of its two 10 in. pipes. 'TANNERY' and 'F. & C. HAFFNER' along Ethan are the tannery's label, not street names.
